test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some flowers are fruits.

All fruits are vegetables.

Some vegetables are healthy.

**Conclusions:**

I. All fruits are healthy.

II. Some vegetables are flowers.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Given Statements:

Some flowers are fruits.

All fruits are vegetables.

Some vegetables are healthy.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6eece74c98c127ab169993edd24abfb8f9fd730932296d249192b99c2a12c54e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All fruits are healthy - False (Because, No definite relation is given between fruits and healthy so this can be a possibility only).

II. Some vegetables are flowers - True (Because, those parts of vegetables which are fruits are also part of flowers).

So, only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
